import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest.mock
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_spec as S, execution_receipt as R
runner_src = pathlib.Path("scripts/execution_runner.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "protected_snapshot(" not in runner_src, "runner must reuse capture_before baseline"
for rel in (".config/git/ignore", ".config/git/attributes"):
    assert rel in R.HOME_PROTECTED_FILES, rel
for mod in ("scripts/json.py", "scripts/os.py", "scripts/sys.py", "scripts/re.py", "tests/json.py", "scripts/.gitignore", ".gitignore"):
    assert not R.in_scope(mod, ["scripts/**", "tests/**", ".gitignore"]), mod
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve()
try:
    home = tmp / "home"; home.mkdir()
    dot = tmp / "dotfiles"
    (dot / "claude" / "commands").mkdir(parents=True)
    (dot / "projects" / "p" / "memory").mkdir(parents=True)
    (dot / "claude" / "settings.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    (dot / "projects" / "p" / "memory" / "m.md").write_text("m", encoding="utf-8")
    (dot / "claude" / "projects").symlink_to(dot / "projects")
    (home / ".claude").symlink_to(dot / "claude")
    repo = tmp / "repo"; (repo / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "t@example.invalid"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "t"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    (repo / ".gitignore").write_text(".tasks/\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "README.md").write_text("hi\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-qm", "init"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    with unittest.mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": str(home)}):
        spec, spec_path, digest = S.construct(role="worker", mission="docs/missions/fixture", feature="F010", work_unit="T-070-R6", attempt=1, provider="claude", model="opus", effort="high", speed="unknown", repo=str(repo), prompt="go", write_scope=["README.md"])
        before = R.capture_before(str(spec_path), digest)
        (home / ".claude" / "sessions").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (home / ".claude" / "sessions" / "1.key").write_text("k", encoding="utf-8")
        (home / ".claude" / "projects" / "p" / "transcript.jsonl").write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) == R._PROTECTED_BASELINES[spec["run_id"]], "symlinked claude/projects volatile writes must not alter snapshot"
        (repo / "scripts" / ".gitignore").write_text(".gitignore\njson.py\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "scripts" / "json.py").write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        log_p = repo / ".tasks" / "logs" / f"{spec['run_id']}.log"
        log_p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); log_p.write_text("ok\n", encoding="utf-8")
        rec = R.build_receipt(spec_path=str(spec_path), digest=digest, before=before, started_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", finished_at="2026-01-01T00:01:00Z", outcome="completed", exit_code=0, log_path=str(log_p), task="docs/missions/fixture/tasks/T-070-R6.md", tier="economy")
        assert rec["scope"]["result"] == "fail"
        assert "scripts/.gitignore" in rec["scope"]["violations"]
        assert "scripts/json.py" in rec["scope"]["violations"]
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
print("ok")
